overview.title: Agua en el borde del desierto
overview.p1: Las Fuentes de Asnaa son una zona de fuentes naturales cerca de Dakhla — una salida terrestre que contrasta con los campamentos de laguna.
overview.p2: Ven por el paisaje más tranquilo y un ritmo más lento que los días de deporte de viento.
overview.p3: El acceso depende de la pista. Lleva agua, protección solar y un plan de regreso claro.

q1.question: What are the Sources d'Asnaa?
q1.answer: A natural water-source area on the desert edge near Dakhla — a quieter land stop compared with the lagoon camps.

q2.question: How do I get there?
q2.answer: By road south or inland from town. Confirm the current track and transfer with a local driver or your camp.

q3.question: Do I need a 4x4?
q3.answer: Depending on the final track condition. Many visitors go with a local driver who knows the access.

q4.question: Are there facilities on site?
q4.answer: Limited. Bring water, sun protection and plan your return before dark.

q5.question: Best time to visit?
q5.answer: Morning for cooler air and clearer light on the desert edge.
